summary: Archon M+ re-cut: 15 tier moves, 10 consensus cells (all M+, one band). Mythicstats merged. Aug-20 hotfix logged, Affliction tierSet advanced. Archon S2 raid data landing at n=1.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 192-340 KB, parsed from <table class="tier-list"> rows (first <td> = the tier letter; each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split at a space, which is what keeps the six two-word-class specs matchable). Per-page counts printed and reconciled against the 27+7+6 roster shape BEFORE merging: raid 27/7/6 + M+ 27/7/6 = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched. ZERO tier moves against stored, raid and M+ alike - consistent with the page dates, which are byte-identical to last night's (raid DPS 2026-08-16, raid healer 08-13, raid tank 08-08, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-16) and agree 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json, so nothing upstream rebuilt in the last 24h. Era read from each page's own title AND body rather than a substring count: four titles self-identify Patch 12.1 / Season 2, and TWO now carry a stale-era title over a Season-2 body - the raid HEALER page ("Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight", 21 Season-2 mentions against 6 Season-1) and the raid DPS page ("Midnight (12.1)", 54 against 14). Body over title, the blue-tracker precedent. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six; no seasonVerified value changed for this source, so it contributes nothing for freeze-season.mjs to do. published re-read per page and NOT carried forward; unchanged. Snapshots 2026-08-20 -> 2026-08-21.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 158/165 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = the letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 40 raid + 40 M+ rows, 0 roster-matching unmatched, no duplicate spec+bracket, ZERO tier moves. The M+ page again carries 8 tier blocks rather than 4 - the extra set is the dungeon-difficulty list, rejected by ROSTER MATCH (the eight Season-2 dungeon names King's Rest / Ruby Life Pools / Voidscar Arena / The Blinding Vale / Den of Nalorakk / Murder Row / Temple of Sethraliss / Altar of Fangs, plus the Method logo alt, all failed to map) and never by position. Era from each page's own BODY: raid "...for Raiding content in the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" (Last Updated 10th August 2026), M+ "...in Midnight Season 2" (Last Updated 13th August 2026) - both dates unchanged from last night. STILL TRUE AND STILL WORTH KNOWING: the pages' <meta description> boilerplate reads "The War Within Season 3" on both, stale site chrome contradicting the rendered body, so an era check reading the meta tag would wrongly drop both pages from the consensus. seasonVerified stays s2 on both; nothing to freeze. Method carries no published field by convention and none was invented. Snapshots 2026-08-20 -> 2026-08-21.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 73-337 KB. Parsed by unescaping \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST and only then finding [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] - never by anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml(, since the raid-healer page carries a decoy call - with tolerant whitespace on [tier-label ...]X [/tier-label] and the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug as the identifier. Exactly one tier-list block per page: 27/7/6 raid + 27/7/6 M+ = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, counts reconciled against the roster shape before merging. ZERO tier moves. Era: all six titles and in-body headings read "for Midnight Season 2" (the raid-healer title still carries the DOUBLE space, "Midnight  Season 2", which is exactly why the era check is not an exact-spacing literal); seasonVerified stays s2, nothing to freeze. published re-read per page and NOT carried forward: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 2026-08-18, raid tank 2026-08-14, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 2026-08-18 - every one unchanged from stored and agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Snapshots 2026-08-20 -> 2026-08-21.

The two brackets remain in different states and the M+ side moved hard for a second consecutive night. All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 48-92 KB, parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists, taking metric "score" for M+ (never the default popularity grouping) and resolving every entry from its icon "Class-Spec" token with tiers[].entries read as a list OF LISTS. M+: 40/40 letters merged, 0 unmatched, letter set unchanged at S/A/B/C, with 15 TIER MOVES, enumerated rather than summarised - two of them cross two bands (Mistweaver Monk S->B, Vengeance DH C->A), and the rest are Subtlety Rogue S->A; Balance Druid, Enhancement Shaman, Windwalker Monk, Marksmanship Hunter, Shadow Priest, Devastation Evoker and Fire Mage all A->B; Frost DK, Beast Mastery Hunter and Destruction Warlock B->C; Protection Paladin and Brewmaster Monk B->A. Read as a genuine week-two re-cut rather than a parse artifact: the M+ parse pool has tripled again overnight (DPS 332,239 -> 950,129; healer 110,677 -> 316,669; tank 110,727 -> 316,628) and the row counts are exactly 27/7/6. CONSENSUS IMPACT WAS SIMULATED BEFORE MERGING, not discovered after: 10 consensus cells move, ALL M+, ALL one band, 0 two-band, 0 vanished - against maxTotalMoves 25 and maxTwoBandMoves 6 - so no ack is needed and none is proposed. RAID: the three raid pages describe Season 2 (titles "Midnight DPS/Healer/Tank Rankings and Raid Tier List") but all three tierLists - popularity, throughput and survivability - are still EMPTY, with totalParses 0. NEW TONIGHT and reported because it is the first movement in this lane: specRankingsSection.table.data is no longer empty on those pages (13 DPS / 4 healer / 2 tank rows), so Archon has begun ingesting S2 raid logs; the tier lists have not followed. Their seasonVerified was again left at s1 DELIBERATELY, the same judgement as 08-19 and 08-20 and for the same reason: the field gates whether the STORED letters feed the live-season consensus, those stored Archon raid letters are still the Season-1 cut, and flipping them to s2 would average S1 opinion into the S2 raid consensus. Nulling the 40 raid letters instead was rejected again because it breaches the archon-tiers row floor (80 -> 40 against min 60) and the 25% row-drop guard, neither of which has an agent-side ack path. OWNER FLAG (third repeat): when Archon's raid tier list populates, re-verify those three pages to s2 in the SAME run that merges the new letters, and expect that night's consensus recomposition to need the human anomaly_ack. Whole-source consequence is the intended one from the 2026-08-19 ancillary:true change: Archon IS in the M+ consensus (4 sources) and out of the raid consensus (3 sources). Snapshots on the 6 aggregate pages 2026-08-20 -> 2026-08-21; the 3 labelled pages left at 2026-08-18 because nothing landed from them.

NOT REFRESHED, and the stored data was deliberately left byte-identical (619 tier rows across 9 Season-1 bosses + 8 Season-1 dungeons, asOf 2026-08-17, top-level season stamp "s1"). Re-probed tonight rather than assumed from last night, four URLs: (1) both registered per-encounter pages (.../raid/mythic/imperator and .../mythic-plus/10/windrunner-spire/this-week) return HTTP 200 with a 199,241-byte generic shell whose __NEXT_DATA__ carries a page object with no title, no tierLists and no totalParses - every stored encounter name remains dead upstream; (2) a Season-2 M+ dungeon page (altar-of-fangs) returns a healthy 27-row score tier list with 104,792 parses; (3) a Season-2 raid boss page (nekzali-the-soulcaller) returns the same page-less shell as the S1 ones. A full S2 rewrite is therefore still structurally blocked and was not attempted: 8 dungeons x 40 specs = at most 320 tier rows with the raid side contributing zero, which is below the archon-encounters row floor of 440 AND a 48% drop against the committed 619, breaching maxRowDropPct 0.25. Both are hard publish-gate errors with no agent-writable ack channel, so the honest move is to leave the S1 file standing and say so. It misleads no visitor: the file's season stamp is s1, liveSeason is s2, and the UI hides the whole Fight selector on exactly that mismatch. OWNER DECISION STILL NEEDED (third night): rebuilding this lane for Season 2 needs a reviewed change to the archon-encounters floor in required-sources.json (a CODEOWNERS file) - either lower it to a dungeons-only reality of ~320, or wait until Venomous Abyss accumulates enough parses that Archon publishes per-boss tiers. Until then this row stays partial and the page snapshot stays 2026-08-18, so the 10-day staleness gate will make the lag visible on its own around 2026-08-28.

The survivability read comes from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages, and those pages returned it EMPTY again tonight (0 entries) alongside throughput and popularity - the Season-2 raid state described in the archon-tiers row, totalParses 0 on the tier lists. Nothing to merge, so the 40 stored survivability tiers are unchanged at their 2026-08-17 asOf and the labelled page snapshot was deliberately not bumped to today: bumping it would restart a 10-day staleness clock on data that did not refresh, and letting that gate fire around 2026-08-28 is the true signal if Archon's raid cut stays empty. The 2026-08-18 re-cut (Blood DK / Brewmaster / Vengeance B->A, Protection Paladin C->A) remains the last real state of this series and is what is published.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" could not be honestly refreshed, but for a NEW reason that changes the standing-red story and should reach the owner. props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data is no longer empty on the Season-2 raid pages: it now carries 13 DPS rows (of 27) and 2 tank rows (of 6). It was NOT merged, and the reason is sample size plus partial roster, both measured: every single row has parses of 1, except Destruction Warlock at 2. A "95th percentile" computed from one parse is that one parse. Merging 13 of 27 would also mix Season-2 values into a season-agnostic metric name alongside 14 surviving Season-1 rows carrying n of 95-682, and metricRanks ranks within (role, bracket, name) - so the 13 re-based specs would all rank below the 14 un-rebased ones purely for having been re-based, publishing WHICH specs Archon has S2 parses for as if it were spec strength. That is the same partial-adoption trap the Bloodmallet sim-tier gate exists to stop. For the record, the deltas that were held back run -11% to -39% (Windwalker 171,021 -> 114,311; Arms 208,648 -> 133,283), all inside maxValueMovePct 0.6, so no gate would have caught this - the judgement is the guard. The 33 stored rows (27 DPS + 6 tank) are byte-identical and keep their 2026-08-16 asOf; nothing was restamped with today. The recipe itself is proven on the same run: the identical path returned 27/7/6 rows on the M+ pages. This series should be re-checked nightly and merged WHOLESALE the first night Archon publishes a full 27-spec raid cut with real parse counts - which will be Season-2 raid DPS replacing Season-1 raid DPS under one name, so expect a value-move check that night.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" is in the same new state as archon-metrics and is reported separately rather than coupled to it, per the split-row rule. The Season-2 raid healer page's specRankingsSection now carries 4 rows of 7 (Preservation Evoker, Holy Paladin, Discipline Priest, Restoration Shaman) where it carried 0 last night - but every one is n=1, and 4 of 7 is a partial roster, so nothing was merged for the reasons set out in archon-metrics. It would also have failed this requirement's own row floor of 5 had it been merged as a replacement. All 7 stored HPS values unchanged at 2026-08-16, nothing merged, no date restamped.

"M+ score (95th pct)" refreshed in full from the three Season-2 M+ pages' specRankingsSection.table.data[] - NOT the tierList structure, which carries only letters: 27 + 7 + 6 = 40/40 rows, 0 unmatched, floats rounded to the stored integer precision (read off specs.json rather than assumed), each row's `parses` carried through as n (950,129 / 316,669 / 316,628 across the three cuts, roughly tripled again as Season-2 keys fill in). Movement is mild now the re-base has happened: family median 2730 -> 2751, +0.8%, well inside maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35, and no row anywhere near maxValueMovePct 0.6 - both computed BEFORE merging. asOf is Archon's own lastUpdated 2026-08-20T12:00:00Z, never the run date.

Half the series refreshed and half could not, so the requirement's coverage date correctly does not move (the min-60th-freshest of 80 rows is a raid row at 2026-08-16). The 40 M+ rows were re-parsed from the Season-2 pages and merged at Archon's own 2026-08-20, shape-checked BEFORE the merge exactly as the recipe requires: every value a plausible percentage (0.3-43.6), the three M+ role groups summing to 100.0 / 100.0 / 100.0, and no row equal to that spec's own 95th-pct DPS (0 clashes) - the check that catches the DPS-column-under-a-%-unit failure. Stored precision is 1 dp and was matched. The 40 RAID rows were NOT refreshed: the S2 raid pages now publish popularity for only 13+4+2 = 19 of 40 specs, at parse counts of 1-2, so the popularity shares they imply (0.07 = one parse of fourteen) describe Archon's S2 ingest progress and not the raid meta - held back with the rest of the raid cut, see archon-metrics. They stay untouched at 2026-08-16. The M+ moves are large in relative terms on small numbers (worst: Augmentation 0.7 -> 0.6, 14%) but every value sits far below the guard's 100-magnitude floor, so the value-move gate does not - and should not - see them.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers/proxy/auth (the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale S3 prerender and was not touched). manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39Z) and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json carrying Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT - the two agree, so unlike the 08-04 case there is no movement hidden behind a pinned manifest, and the rankings file was cache-busted and DIFFED rather than trusted to the manifest date. Selected by WHITELIST (categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField === "lowerBound" + keyRange === undefined, never a "not dungeon" blacklist, because melee/ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count 27 specs) = 27+7+6 = 40 rows from 44 blocks, 40/40 name-matched with no mapping table. All 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts identical to stored at the stored 1-dp precision. Nothing merged; asOf stays the SOURCE's snapshotDate 2026-08-11, never today. Upstream has now not run a pipeline for 10 days - it last ran the day 12.1 shipped - so this is two days past the contract's 8-day threshold and the heartbeat reds on it. That red is accurate and is the owner-accepted standing red recorded in the requirement's own label; it clears when WoWMeta re-runs.

No WCL fetch by this agent: it holds no credentials and did not touch warcraftlogs.com by any transport, API or HTML. Read from wcl-fetch/evidence.json (attemptedAt 2026-08-21T11:00:57.617Z, this run) which reports verdict "rdps-broken" - OAuth and GraphQL are healthy (3600 points/hour, 1 spent) but characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returns a bare "Internal server error", so the whole redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream. Separately the HTML statistics transport has been Cloudflare-challenged since 2026-08-10 from residential IPs too; the two are independent facts and neither was used as evidence about the other. evidence.landed is empty and carries no entry for wcl-live-raid, so the zone-53 (The Venomous Abyss, Mythic) medians could not land and the 47 stored rows are unchanged at 2026-08-10. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED recorded in the requirement's own label: no S2 fetch path exists, the staleness alarm firing at 11 days IS the intended signal, and it clears when a zone-53 recipe lands in src/fetch-wcl.mjs - not by acking it away.

No WCL fetch by this agent (no credentials; warcraftlogs.com was not contacted by any means). Same evidence file and same verdict as wcl-live-raid - "rdps-broken", attemptedAt 2026-08-21T11:00:57.617Z, transport healthy, metric family 500ing - and evidence.landed has no entry for wcl-live-mplus, so the zone-55 (Mythic+ Season 2) medians could not land and the 40 stored rows are unchanged at 2026-08-10. Owner-accepted standing red, per the requirement label; it clears when a zone-55 recipe lands in src/fetch-wcl.mjs, which is an owner decision and not an agent one.

All 3 meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 41-71 KB, 40/40 rows parsed from the meta-item blocks, 0 unmatched, counts reconciled at 27/7/6. NOTHING MERGED and the row is partial rather than success, because upstream has not re-run: the pages' own published timestamp reads datetime="2026-08-20T03:32:10Z", identical to the stamp this series already carries, and all 40 values are byte-identical to stored (median 2744.5, range 2346-2898, no zeros). Recording success on an unchanged fetch is exactly the wowmeta-freeze failure mode, so asOf stays the SOURCE's 2026-08-20 rather than being restamped with the run date. Pages still self-identify "Mythic+ in Midnight Season 2". Page snapshots 2026-08-20 -> 2026-08-21, because the pages themselves were successfully read today - the staleness gate for this requirement reads the data's own coverage date, not that snapshot, so this cannot paper anything over.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 5 attempts each. 17 specs return real data and the SAME 10 as the last two nights still return the 76-byte {"status": "error", "message": "No standard chart with these values found."} body persistently (Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms, Fury) - that body was retried rather than treated as structural, per the Beast Mastery precedent, and the roster is identical to last night's 17, so there is no progress upstream in 24h. Every one of the 17 carries simc_settings.tier "MID2" (read off each chart, never hard-coded - it moves each season) with chart timestamps of 2026-08-19, while the 26 stored profiles are MID1-era. MERGED NOTHING, per the sim-tier uniformity gate: MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1 and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key, so a 17-of-27 merge would publish WHICH specs have been re-simmed as if it were spec strength. Adopt a new tier wholesale or not at all. simc_settings.ptr was compared explicitly against the STRING "0". fightProfile.asOf therefore stays at the CHARTS' own 2026-07-08 / 07-15 - 44 days stale - and the heartbeat stays red, which is the true signal that upstream has not finished re-simming. FOR THE OWNER, unchanged: when the last 10 specs land, the wholesale adoption will itself need a value_move_ack, since MID2-vs-MID1 moves most sim rows well past the 60% per-row limit.

The standing recipe ran and the answer is unchanged. MID1_Raid.txt is a 272-byte LIVE IN-PROGRESS run with no "DPS Ranking:" block (header SimulationCraft 1210-01, 12.1.0.69404 Live, hotfix 2026-08-21/69404, git build HEAD 69a46e15b4 - moved again from last night's 3e75e1b590), so it fell back to MID1_Raid.html, which is UNCHANGED at SimulationCraft 1205-01, 12.0.7.68974 Live, hotfix 2026-08-06/68974, own timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33. Re-parsed anyway rather than short-circuited: took the "data":[...] array ENCLOSING the first big-value MID1_ hit (a fixed byte window after "series" reads the later burst/DTPS charts at 2.2-2.5x inflation) and mapped profile names by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed - 49 profiles -> 26 DPS specs, all 26 byte-identical to stored; the 9 unmapped names are tank profiles (Brewmaster, Protection Warrior, Guardian, two Vengeance builds, Protection Paladin x2, two Blood builds), excluded by design. Nothing merged - an unchanged build is the honest explanation for an unchanged parse. MID2 re-checked and still NOT adoptable, for the same two independently verified reasons as last night: (a) MID2_Raid.txt's header self-identifies 12.1.0.69382 PTR where MID1's reads Live, and (b) its "DPS Ranking:" block is a PARTIAL run of 33 distinct profiles (up one from 32) drawn from only ten classes - Death Knight, Demon Hunter, Hunter, Mage, Monk, Paladin, Priest, Rogue, Shaman and Warlock, with Druid, Evoker and Warrior absent entirely - which is the same which-specs-got-re-simmed trap the Bloodmallet tier gate exists to stop, and the stored metric name "SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS" is season-agnostic so a partial swap would publish silently. OWNER DECISION unchanged: adopting MID2 is a source-definition change (the registry page is MID1_Raid.html) and should wait for a complete, Live-flagged MID2 run. At 13 days the contract's 10-day gate is firing on this, correctly - the owner-accepted standing red in the requirement's own label.

https://mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched server-rendered (r.jina.ai is Cloudflare-403 on this host), 302 -> /period/1077, HTTP 200, 211 KB: the SAME period as the last two nights, still live and still moving - it now reads "Top 2000 keys, 10000 characters (4549 unique), 13.3 average key level" against last night's "(5914 unique), 12.1 average key level", so the top-2000 cut is being re-drawn from a rising key pool rather than re-counted. Parse bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section and terminated at the next <h2> (scanning the whole page yields 59 rows from the Classes-and-specs and per-dungeon blocks) with lowercase-hyphenated labels normalised on [-\s]+ and whitespace allowed around the bare number: 40 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates. Verified it is the representation SHARE column and not the /meta per-key-PRESENCE column BEFORE merging - series sum 100.4%, the page's own role subtotals reading Ranged 28.6 / Melee 31.4 / Tank 20.0 / Healer 20.0, max row 12.0, no zeros anywhere. 37 of 40 values moved as the key pool turned over (Blood DK 10.1 -> 12.0, Arms Warrior 8.7 -> 10.6, Balance Druid 3.6 -> 2.7); every value is far below the guard's 100-magnitude floor, so the value-move gate correctly does not see them. asOf 2026-08-21: the page publishes no date of its own and the period is live, so the run date is the honest stamp here (unlike wowmeta, murlok and bloodmallet, which do publish one).

Four channels swept, all healthy, one entry landed. (1) Wowhead news RSS parsed per <item> block (never by tag adjacency): 40 items, newest 2026-08-20 22:51 CDT. (2) The news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute) because it leads RSS within a run - it tops out at the same news=382552, so the two agree and nothing landed mid-run. (3) Blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries, 35 unique topics, newest 2026-08-20 21:35; no standalone class-tuning blue post - the only Kaivax topics are the hotfix round-up itself and "Item Adjustment Incoming - August 25", already checked in full on 08-20 (one item, no class line). (4) Dev-notes thread 2317811.json via curl for the full post_stream (WebFetch truncates to post 1): 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31, newest still Linxy #19 - the closed 12.1 cycle's expected quiet, not a lost thread. NO 12.2 PTR announcement in any channel. LOGGED: a kind:"hotfix" entry dated 2026-08-20, verified against the CANONICAL forum source rather than the Wowhead mirror - Kaivax's running hotfix topic 2336376, whose title has rolled to "World of Warcraft: Midnight Hotfixes - August 20" and whose post 1 was edited 2026-08-21T02:27:47Z to append that section - and cited via wowheadUrl news=382550 because a hotfix has no post in the tracked thread. Read with the cooked <ul> nesting INTACT, which settled the run's one attribution question: the Hellcaller line sits directly under the bare Warlock heading, one level SHALLOWER than the four Affliction lines, so it is logged "Warlock (Hellcaller hero talents)" (a hero-tree scope) and not as an Affliction line. Seven highlights over six specs plus that hero-tree line; specsAffected and highlights reconcile 7/7 under the coverage gate. Classification was CHECKED against classifyHighlight rather than asserted: 5 of 7 classify null, but two DO vote - Marksmanship Hunter NERF (both its lines remove a damage double-dip) and Elemental Shaman BUFF (Master of the Elements now increases Earthquake damage) - and the entry's label says so. Neither moved an outlook DIRECTION, because both specs are driven by a dated writeup verdict rather than the tally: Marksmanship stays Mixed/flat at +5/-2, Elemental stays Positive/up at +2/-1; only their stated line counts moved. ONE SET BONUS IS TOUCHED: the last Affliction Warlock line fixes the Unstable Affliction granted by the Venomous Abyss 4-piece failing to grant a stack of Wither, so that spec's tierSet.asOf advanced 2026-07-08 -> 2026-08-20 with source re-pointed at the forum topic and a dated parenthetical appended; the 4-piece WORDING is unchanged, which is why the stored bonus text was not rewritten. The tier-set upkeep gate is green by fact, not by omission. KNOWN CONSEQUENCE, FLAGGED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER: advancing that tierSet trips the heartbeat's gearing-tierset-sync check (`check-refresh --age` now reports "1 spec(s) carry tier-set text the tracker has since corrected"), because gearing/data still holds the pre-hotfix Affliction text. The documented fix is `node gearing/src/sync-tracker-fields.mjs`, and this agent deliberately did NOT run it: the publish job stages only data/, dist/ and the skill logs, so a gearing/ edit would never be committed and would only desynchronise the run artifact. It is a LOCAL-run duty (gearing harvests are manual by design) and the red is the correct signal until then - it is measuring wrongness, not age, which is exactly the Preservation Evoker failure of 2026-08-08. Swept and correctly NOT logged, each read: "Heroic Vashnik Stealthily Nerfed" (news=382552) and "Nightmare Prey Affix Nerfed" (news=382549), both encounter/affix tuning with no class line; and the post's own Delves, Dungeons and Raids (including the seven Heroic Ula'tek tuning lines), Items, Prey, Quests and Treasures sections. Writeup lane recomputed rather than quoted: 1 spec at ptr:null (Demonology Warlock, the deliberate null), and expertRead still returns null for all 40 specs in both brackets by construction, since it gates on PHASES.ptr and the 12.1 PTR phase ended at the flip.

Discovery complete, distillation impossible - 0 takes and 0 metaNotes added, no `latest` advanced. transcript-fetch/summary.json reports verdict "ok" with requested 0 / fetched 0, because data/pending-transcripts.json was EMPTY when the deterministic step ran (a 2026-08-20 local run drained the two videos this nightly queued on 08-20 and distilled them - 2 Obli DK takes and 6 Dorki tank takes are in creator-takes.json), so no transcript existed to distil from tonight. No transcript was fetched from YouTube or any API by this agent. 44 unique channel feeds polled with 3-attempt backoff (119 creator entries, 40 of them transcribable:false, sharing them), 44/44 HTTP 200, 660 entries diffed against a 1162-id seen-set built from the four STRUCTURED lanes (pending-transcripts seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] + every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url), never a regex over log prose. 65 unseen, all 65 in-cycle against the 2026-06-18 bound (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, taken as a date and not as builds[0]). The count is DOWN from last night's 97 not because 32 were retired but because YouTube RSS holds only 15 entries per channel and the tail scrolled out - that is a real, recorded loss of reach, not progress. TWO QUEUED under the nightly's keyword filter and the fetch-broadly/queue-narrowly rule that protects Supadata's 100-request MONTHLY budget, both chosen on their media:description rather than their title: izen gGzU0vD8R6M "Season 2 Mythic+ Talking Points: Boltslop, Minibosses and Less AoE DPS", whose description carries his own chapter list ending in "10:27 DPS Damage Profiles" - a generalCreators entry, so the metaNotes lane; and Nintern k0mCjMlwyys "Midnight Season 2 Devourer Sim Update", squarely inside his registered Devourer/Havoc scope and the first sim-update content of the live season. NOTHING was retired to seen[]: no dismissal tonight is durable.
